decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the Cephalid Breakfast combo to mill cards quickly and efficiently in order to win the game. By combining cards like Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist with Thassa's Oracle, the deck aims to deck itself out and win instantly. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares for protection and removal, as well as cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. Urza's Saga is used to search for key combo pieces, while Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect against disruption.

The main idea behind this deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan while deploying aggressive creatures to quickly close out the game. By using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down your opponent's spells, alongside disruptive lands like Karakas and Rishadan Port, you can control the pace of the game. Additionally, with powerful equipment like Stoneforge Mystic and Solitude to support your creatures, you can apply pressure while protecting your own board. This deck aims to create a difficult board state for your opponent to deal with and secure a victory through efficient aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by utilizing disruptive spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a fast and aggressive approach. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to disrupt the opponent's plays, while also using efficient threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, Murktide Regent, and Brazen Borrower to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes card draw and selection with Ponder, Brainstorm, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to ensure consistency and adaptability in different matchups.

This deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong tempo advantage. By combining disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze with powerful creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to control the game and slowly chip away at the opponent's life total. Additionally, the deck includes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push to deal with threats, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help maintain card advantage and ensure consistent draws. The mana base is designed to support the deck's curves and maximize efficiency.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures. The deck aims to maintain control of the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while also generating card advantage and card selection. By effectively using the spells and abilities of the cards in the deck, the player can outmaneuver their opponent and dictate the pace of the game, eventually leading to a victory.

With a mix of efficient removal, disruptive spells, and powerful threats, this Aggro - Jund deck aims to control the board and come out on top in the race to victory.

The primary focus of this Control - Lands deck is to disrupt opponent's strategy by utilizing mana denial and resource denial tactics. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's plays with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland, while also utilizing Land recursion with Life from the Loam and Exploration to generate advantage. The deck also has a combo finish with Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, allowing for a quick win condition. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through resource management and strategic land usage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, card advantage, and card selection. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to generate card advantage and control the board. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to answer threats. With the use of cards like Snapcaster Mage and Mystic Sanctuary, the deck can effectively reuse key spells like Force of Will and Terminus to maintain control and outvalue opponents.

This Legacy Aggro deck focuses on utilizing Ninjas to quickly and efficiently control the game. By using cards like Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow and Ingenious Infiltrator to take advantage of Ninjutsu abilities, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while dealing damage directly. With support from cards like Ornithopter and Baleful Strix for early defense and card draw, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of evasive creatures and disruption spells. Retrofitter Foundry provides additional value by creating artifact creature tokens to further pressure the opponent.

This deck aims to assemble the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire deck in one turn. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Memory Guardian provide recursion and protection for the combo pieces. Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble provide card draw and triggers for Emry. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Pithing Needle, as well as utility lands like Urza's Saga. The goal is to quickly set up the combo while controlling the game with disruptive spells and efficient mana generation.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Unmask to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck aims to take advantage of the graveyard as a resource and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures early in the game. Additionally, cards like Smallpox and Liliana of the Veil help control the board and disrupt the opponent's resources.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using spells like Reanimate, Shallow Grave, and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a quick win. The key strategy is to use cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting to set up the graveyard and disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy. The deck also includes ways to generate mana quickly with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to ensure you can cast your reanimation spells as soon as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently bring out powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. By utilizing cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal for mana acceleration, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its high impact creatures and potentially win the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes a number of cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the key combo pieces needed for a successful win condition.
